runtime.seed_note: Fixed ordered inference and matching, no stochastic training, search or split.

hypotheses.detection: Larger or different pretrained models improve fog localization and small-object recall.
hypotheses.association: Kalman prediction and global box assignment reduce identity switches on the same inputs.
hypotheses.end_to_end: The best alert setting in development transfers to unseen nighttime views.
hypotheses.cuda: ONNX Runtime CUDA improves throughput with equivalent alerts for the same YOLOX export.

tracking.detection_scores: Retain authors' detections and treat them all as strong

decisions.yolox_m: Retained as an option for box accuracy. The better DAWN result did not improve event recall in the replay.
decisions.tiles: Opt-in. Slower and lower AP on DAWN.
decisions.bytetrack: Retained as an option for identity consistency.
decisions.ocsort_rtdetr: Retained as options. Two development matches with no extra alerts, zero of two matches on the frozen night clips.
decisions.cuda: Retained as a tested application backend. Default CPU baseline remains accessible.
